description: Copy bundled lib/ files from CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT into CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA. Registered on BOTH Setup{init} (fires during `claude --init-only` pre-pass for fast first-install) AND SessionStart (fires every session, picks up plugin updates and self-heals manual deletion). The manifest-diff check in sync-lib.sh makes repeat invocations a fast no-op when content is unchanged.
